Enjoy the melodious track "Pyar Chahiye Kitni Baar" from the film Waqt Ki Awaz (1998) starring Mithun Chakraborty and Sridevi. Composed by the music maestro Bappi Lahiri, this song captures the essence of love and romance with his signature style. A nostalgic melody from the late 90s that continues to charm Bollywood music lovers.
